metricDenominators.overallCorrectness: All 500 core cases, including failed, pending and unavailable cases.
metricDenominators.minimumCategoryCorrectness: All 50 frozen cases in each category.
metricDenominators.compileSuccess: Functionally correct and compiled cases over all 100 predeclared eligible exact-board cases; missing expert/compiler receipts block completion and never shrink this cohort.
metricDenominators.adversarialSuccess: All 100 mandatory adversarial cases must pass independent expert grading.
metricDenominators.multiTurnSuccess: All 50 acceptance multi-turn cases, with every exchange evaluated in one isolated session.
metricDenominators.citationCorrectness: Correct emitted citations over all required/emitted citations; signed counts require at least 50 eligible decisions.
metricDenominators.supportedClaimAccuracy: Supported verifiable claims over all verifiable claims and required answers; signed counts require at least 50 decisions.
metricDenominators.retrievalRecallAt5: Queries returning their relevant record among the first five over all answerable queries; at least 50 signed query decisions.
metricDenominators.maximumAnswerCollapse: Core cases sharing a nonempty answer across distinct template families after removing prompt echoes, over all 500 core cases. Expert relevance grading additionally catches paraphrased template failures.

scale.2: correct, relevant, complete enough and justified

splitIsolation.semanticGuarantee: Lexical checks plus family/source provenance and independent audit; no claim of universal semantic leak detection.

seal.custody: Before candidate training, export sealed acceptance material to an evaluation-only identity/location. Runtime adapters receive inputs only; target/oracle access is forbidden.

changePolicy: New version and full re-evaluation for changed suite/rubric/thresholds; no overwrite of frozen files or historical scores.
